newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: UNICEF says Ugandan children abducted, raped.
newsitem.headline: UNICEF says Ugandan children abducted, raped.

text.p: The United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) on Thursday called on countries to stop Uganda's rebels from abducting, killing, maiming and raping schoolchildren.
Executive Director Carol Bellamy, in a statement, suggested that putting pressure on neighbouring Sudan, alleged to be training the rebels, might be one way to stop the abuse.

The rebels, made up of roaming gangs called the Lord's Resistance Army, have unleashed waves of terror among 200,000 people in the northern part of the country where support for Ugandan President Yoweri Kaguta Museveni is weakest.
"We have to identify beyond a shadow of a doubt, those from whom the LRA are drawing support for their despicable campaign," Bellamy said.
"Concerned international pressure in the right places could put an end to the abductions of children, if not to the war itself," she said. "This problem is neither too big nor too complex to solve."

Bellamy, the former director of the U.S. Peace Corps, estimated that as many as 6,000 to 10,000 children may have been abducted over the last two years. She said they were often killed if they tried to escape.
Boys, she said, had to carry arms and equipment back and forth from Sudan while girls were sexually abused and given as "wives" in lieu of other forms of payment.
Both boys and girls were forced to take part in armed attacks, often on their own villages and communities.
The rebels are led by a former Roman Catholic catechist, Joseph Kony.
Sudan has denied assisting the rebels. It accuses Uganda of aiding its enemies in southern Sudan where Christian and animist Sudanese are fighting the Islamic government in Khartoum.
Bellamy quoted a 12-year-old boy called David who related how one child attempted to escape.

"All the children were given a big stick and were ordered to beat him till he died," he was reported to have said. "Sometimes when I am sleeping, the boy we killed visits me and accuses me of killing him when he was innocent."
